method: Visual reading of all neutral native/raw/excess pages; all covering-order panels seen. Fixed source selection, detector context and previous project findings known; not blinded scientific validation or human review.
mapping_caveat: Inherited local mapping flags use spatial offsets only. Every event with a failed covering-order mapping remains M, even where charge-like morphology is visible.
interpretation: All A/O/U/M judgments are provisional. O uses fibre-compatible morphology and topocentric oxygen-line proximity; no independent sky fibre is available. Neighbouring calibration fibre brightness is not an artifact/sky classifier.
